knowledge.title: What are AI Agents
knowledge.content: AI agents are intelligent software systems capable of understanding goals, making decisions, using tools, calling APIs, accessing databases, retrieving documents, and executing multi-step workflows with minimal human intervention.

knowledge.title: Services
knowledge.content: GrowthsStack.Dev builds custom AI agents for startups, businesses, healthcare, SaaS platforms, customer support, CRM automation, sales automation, data analysis, internal operations, and enterprise software.

knowledge.title: Capabilities
knowledge.content: AI agents can answer questions, search documents, retrieve company knowledge, analyze files, generate reports, schedule appointments, send emails, call APIs, automate repetitive tasks, and interact with multiple software systems.

knowledge.title: Technology Stack
knowledge.content: AI agents are built using Python, FastAPI, OpenAI API, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, Vector Databases, REST APIs, OAuth, JWT Authentication, Webhooks, AWS, and Next.js.

knowledge.title: LLM Support
knowledge.content: Supported models include OpenAI GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, and local open-source language models depending on project requirements.

knowledge.title: Business Automation
knowledge.content: AI agents automate repetitive workflows such as customer support, HR screening, invoice processing, lead qualification, CRM updates, reporting, and internal operations.

knowledge.title: Integrations
knowledge.content: AI agents can integrate with WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Gmail, Outlook, Google Sheets, Notion, Airtable, Stripe, PayPal, Shopify, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Make.com, and custom APIs.

knowledge.title: Deployment
knowledge.content: AI agents can be deployed on cloud servers, Docker containers, VPS, AWS, DigitalOcean, Azure, GCP, Render, Railway, or on-premise infrastructure.

knowledge.title: RAG Support
knowledge.content: AI agents support Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), enabling them to answer questions using business documents, PDFs, websites, databases, SOPs, manuals, and internal knowledge.

knowledge.title: Security
knowledge.content: AI agents include authentication, role-based access control, encrypted communication, secure APIs, logging, audit trails, and permission management.

faqs.question: What is an AI agent?
faqs.answer: An AI agent is an intelligent software system that can understand goals, make decisions, perform tasks, use tools, and automate workflows.

faqs.question: Can you build AI agents?
faqs.answer: Yes. GrowthsStack.Dev develops custom AI agents tailored to business requirements.

faqs.question: Can AI agents use APIs?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI agents can securely connect with REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and third-party services.

faqs.question: Can AI agents read PDFs?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI agents can search, analyze, summarize, and answer questions from PDFs and other documents using RAG.

faqs.question: Can AI agents use databases?
faqs.answer: Yes. They can interact with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, and vector databases.

faqs.question: Can AI agents automate my business?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI agents can automate customer support, CRM updates, reporting, scheduling, document processing, and many repetitive tasks.

faqs.question: Can AI agents send emails?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI agents can send emails, notifications, reminders, and follow-ups automatically.

faqs.question: Can AI agents integrate with WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI agents can integrate with WhatsApp Business API for customer communication and automation.

faqs.question: Can AI agents integrate with CRM?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI agents work with HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, and custom CRM platforms.

faqs.question: Do AI agents support multiple languages?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI agents can communicate in English, Roman English, Urdu, and many other languages depending on the selected AI model.
